core_obligations: (1) implies (2): base change the universal closedness to Spec(A) and apply the scheme case on the cover U x_Y Spec(A).
(2) implies (3) is immediate (R is a valuation ring).

(3) implies (1): given x' -> x in |X| over y' -> y in |Y|, lift to the cover; the valuative criterion on the scheme cover produces the filled square; push down along the etale cover using that specializations lift.
proof_roadmap: Base change to the valuation ring; immediate weakening; valuative filling and push-down.
difficulty_reason: A three-condition equivalence mixing base change, the scheme case, and a valuative filling pushed through an etale cover.
